evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, preflight reads repair.cq_bin and stores measure_cq_bin() at line 749, but the pre-hold path has no require that a configured absolute runtime path exists. A missing entry is therefore admitted; the runtime pointer check only runs after the switch, so rollback to the prior SHA/config can restore the checkout yet fail the same check before triggers restart. This is a concrete rollback-safety defect in existing intended behavior, not a new requirement.
